name: Cyberteller Config
description: Configures cyberteller's boot environment for every cyberteller grain in this Sandstorm install. Hosts the ConfigGate Grapple capability cyberteller claims at first launch — the single source of truth for AITX_URL, FINREACT_SIDECAR_URL, FINREACT_TRUST_BUNDLE, FINREACT_CREDIT_PRIVKEY, FINREACT_TEMP_SUSPENSE_GLID, and FINREACT_COLD_WALLET_GLID. Admin-form gated on the Sandstorm `admin` permission bit (HT12: real UserInfo, no bypass). The credit privkey is operator-pasted from the offline-wallet ceremony (HT13).
